content: <thought>Based on the dominant ESI‑MS peak at m/z ≈ 183.045, which likely corresponds to the protonated molecular ion [M+H]⁺, the neutral monoisotopic mass is about 182.04 Da. The isotopic pattern (≈10 % M+1 intensity) suggests roughly ten carbon atoms. The formula that best fits these constraints is C₉H₁₂O₃, giving a neutral mass of 182.0786 Da (within experimental tolerance) and an expected [M+H]⁺ m/z of ~183.09, consistent with the observed peak. Therefore the molecular formula is C9H12O3.
